name: Kimi ni Yuuwaku! Young Idol Suiei Taikai
original_name: 君に誘惑！ヤングアイドル水泳大会
source:
The protagonist's girlfriend Memi is a promising new idol. She moves to Tokyo for work and keeps distant love relations. She is arranged to participate in "Young Idol Swimming Tournament" annual program. But she does not perceive the true nature of underground celebrity world...

From the dark corners of the show business come men who desire this girl. Memi is very successful at satisfying the crowds - but can she keep her own chastity?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url] and [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ032596.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角的女友芽美是一位前途无量的新晋偶像。她因工作搬到东京，只能维持着聚少离多的恋情。她被安排参加年度节目《年轻偶像游泳大赛》。然而，她并没有看清演艺圈地下世界的真实面貌……

演艺圈的阴暗角落里，有些男人正觊觎着这个女孩。芽美非常擅长满足观众的期待，但她能守住自己的贞洁吗？
